layout.description: Plan your salary, place every expense in a budget, and build your own roadmap to reach your goals. ParaRotam turns saving into a habit and goals into a route.

login.title: Welcome.
login.subtitle: Sign in and pick up your route where you left off.

register.title: Start with ParaRotam.
register.subtitle: Create your account in a few steps and begin charting your own financial route.
register.userNameHelper: You can use this instead of email when signing in. Only letters, digits, . _ -
register.passwordHelper: At least 8 characters with one uppercase letter and one number.
register.errorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
register.errorUserNameTooShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
register.successCreated: Account created. Let's verify your email.

verify.title: Verify your email.
verify.subtitleWithEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
verify.subtitleNoEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email address.
verify.infoResent: A new code has been sent.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: No worries. Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit reset code.
forgot.sentSubtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

reset.title: Set your new password.
reset.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email and create your new password.
reset.errorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
reset.successUpdated: Password updated. You can sign in now.
